card.name: Ending of lenticular and glomerular
card.fires_on: The closing piece "ular" in words like lenticular and glomerular, and the "anter" piece inside vilanterol. It fires partway through these split-up words.

modes.label: -ular endings
modes.description: The final piece "ular" after a split stem such as lentic or glomer.

modes.label: Inside vilanterol
modes.description: The middle piece "anter" in the drug name vilanterol.

card.plain: It marks the end of a long word that was split up, such as glomerular or lenticular.
